description: Times the GPU event interval for one empty dispatch and the host bracket around event recording, launch, and synchronization. Neither interval isolates host launch-call latency. Sweep grid geometry; interpret very short times against the target timer resolution.

scaling_param.name: num_blocks
scaling_param.description: Number of thread blocks in the (empty) grid; primary axis for launch/scheduling overhead

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block in the empty grid

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: When true, run the untimed vector-add warmer before each timed operation to raise clocks and disturb cache state; qualify the resulting state on the target. False disables the warmer without promising a particular cache state.
